pagetitle: "Search"

```{=html}
<div class="v2v-search-page">
<form class="v2v-search" role="search" id="v2v-search-form" action="search.html">
  <label class="visually-hidden" for="v2v-search-q">Search the hub</label>
  <input id="v2v-search-q" type="search" name="q" placeholder="Type a word, such as codebook or read_csv" autocomplete="off">
  <button type="submit">Search</button>
</form>
<fieldset class="v2v-search-courses">
  <legend>Show results for</legend>
  <label><input type="radio" name="course" value="mc451" form="v2v-search-form"> MC 451</label>
  <label><input type="radio" name="course" value="mc501" form="v2v-search-form"> MC 501</label>
  <label><input type="radio" name="course" value="mc427" form="v2v-search-form"> MC 427</label>
  <label><input type="radio" name="course" value="all" form="v2v-search-form"> All courses</label>
</fieldset>
<p id="v2v-search-status" role="status" aria-live="polite"></p>
<div id="v2v-results"></div>
<noscript><p>Search needs JavaScript, which is turned off in this browser. Without it, start from your course page: <a href="mc451/index.html">MC 451</a> or <a href="mc501/index.html">MC 501</a>.</p></noscript>
</div>
<script type="module">
/* search-2026-11-14: Pagefind (built by tools/course-layer.ts after each full render). Results
   come back grouped by kind, guides first, and filtered to one course unless "All courses". */
const NAMES = { mc451: 'MC 451', mc501: 'MC 501', mc427: 'MC 427' };
const GROUPS = [
  ['Guides', ['Guide']],
  ['Help and reference', ['Help', 'Reference']],
  ['Assignments and syllabus', ['Assignment', 'Syllabus']],
  ['Getting started', ['Setup']],
  ['Course pages and the textbook', ['Course page', 'Textbook part', 'Page']],
  ['Slides and self-checks', ['Slides', 'Self-check']],
];
const form = document.getElementById('v2v-search-form');
const radios = document.querySelector(".v2v-search-courses");
const box = document.getElementById('v2v-search-q');
const status = document.getElementById('v2v-search-status');
const out = document.getElementById('v2v-results');
const params = new URLSearchParams(location.search);
let course = params.get('course');
if (!NAMES[course] && course !== 'all') {
  let v = null;
  try { v = localStorage.getItem('v2v-show-grad-ext'); } catch (e) {}
  course = v === '1' ? 'mc501' : v === '0' ? 'mc451' : 'all';
}
radios.querySelector(`input[name="course"][value="${course}"]`).checked = true;
box.value = params.get('q') || '';

let pagefind = null;
async function load() {
  if (pagefind) return pagefind;
  const base = new URL('.', location.href).pathname;
  pagefind = await import(base + 'pagefind/pagefind.js');
  await pagefind.options({ baseUrl: base, excerptLength: 24 });
  return pagefind;
}
function el(tag, cls, text) {
  const e = document.createElement(tag);
  if (cls) e.className = cls;
  if (text !== undefined) e.textContent = text;
  return e;
}
let run = 0;
async function search() {
  const q = box.value.trim();
  const c = radios.querySelector('input[name="course"]:checked').value;
  const url = new URL(location.href);
  url.searchParams.set('q', q); url.searchParams.set('course', c);
  history.replaceState(null, '', url);
  out.textContent = '';
  if (!q) { status.textContent = 'Type a word or a topic, then press Search.'; return; }
  const mine = ++run;
  status.textContent = 'Searching...';
  let pf;
  try { pf = await load(); } catch (e) {
    status.textContent = 'Search could not load. Reload the page and try again.'; return;
  }
  const res = await pf.search(q, c === 'all' ? {} : { filters: { course: NAMES[c] } });
  const data = await Promise.all(res.results.slice(0, 40).map(r => r.data()));
  if (mine !== run) return;
  const where = c === 'all' ? 'all courses' : NAMES[c];
  if (!data.length) {
    status.textContent = `No pages in ${where} match "${q}". Try a shorter word, or choose All courses.`;
    return;
  }
  status.textContent = `${res.results.length} ${res.results.length === 1 ? 'page matches' : 'pages match'} "${q}" in ${where}.` +
    (res.results.length > 40 ? ' The first 40 are below.' : '');
  for (const [label, kinds] of GROUPS) {
    const hits = data.filter(d => kinds.includes((d.filters.kind || ['Page'])[0]));
    if (!hits.length) continue;
    out.appendChild(el('h2', '', label));
    const ol = el('ol');
    for (const d of hits) {
      const li = el('li');
      const a = el('a', '', d.meta.title || d.url);
      const sub = (d.sub_results || []).find(s => s.url !== d.url && s.url.includes('#'));
      a.href = d.url;
      li.appendChild(a);
      const courses = (d.filters.course || []).join(', ');
      li.appendChild(el('p', 'v2v-hit-where', courses ? `${(d.filters.kind || ['Page'])[0]}, ${courses}` : (d.filters.kind || ['Page'])[0]));
      const t = el('p', 'v2v-hit-text'); t.innerHTML = d.excerpt; li.appendChild(t);
      if (sub && sub.title) {
        const p = el('p', 'v2v-hit-text');
        const s = el('a', '', `Go to the section: ${sub.title}`); s.href = sub.url;
        p.appendChild(s); li.appendChild(p);
      }
      ol.appendChild(li);
    }
    out.appendChild(ol);
  }
}
form.addEventListener('submit', e => { e.preventDefault(); search(); });
radios.querySelectorAll('input[name="course"]').forEach(r => r.addEventListener('change', () => { if (box.value.trim()) search(); }));
if (box.value.trim()) search(); else box.focus();
</script>
```
